stories.title: Hardwick slowing down race for County Executive; Burke, Chimera, Lavin throwing their hat in the ring according to party Chair
stories.summary: Erie County Comptroller Kevin Hardwick says he's slowing down his campaign for County Executive, while the party Chair says 3 others want to pitch for endorsement.

stories.title: Josh Allen's debut documentary showcases Buffalo's resilience during 2022 blizzard
stories.summary: The HBO documentary on the McDonald’s that sheltered more than 50 people during the 2022 blizzard gets a special showing at North Park Theater.

stories.title: Buffalo Bills and FeedMore WNY team up for annual 'Thanksgiving Blitz'
stories.summary: FeedMore WNY and the Buffalo Bills held their annual 'Thanksgiving Blitz' Tuesday, providing food to over 600 local families.

stories.title: Fire tears through North Tonawanda apartment building Tuesday night
stories.summary: A fire in an Oliver Street apartment in North Tonawanda severely damaged the mix-use building, and may be a total loss, city fire officials say.

stories.title: Buffalo man arrested on warrant tied to 2018 shooting in New Orleans, North Tonawanda woman charged for allegedly inhibiting investigation
stories.summary: A Buffalo man has been taken into custody on an arrest warrant tied to a 2018 shooting in New Orleans, according to the Erie County Sheriff's Office.

stories.title: Experts say recent nationwide tech outages are not connected
stories.summary: A string of tech failures hit the U.S. in a matter of days. Experts say the timing is unsettling, but there isn't evidence that points to something nefarious.

stories.title: Buffalo School Board member raises concerns over updated school closure and consolidation proposal
stories.summary: Questions the impact on students, school communities and projected savings as the district prepares for a vote on its revised consolidation plan

stories.title: Buffalo City Council updated on police hiring while staffing concerns persist: no new officers "until 2028"
stories.summary: Buffalo faces a looming police staffing crisis as retirements surge and new hirings stall. Concerned Council members warn of financial and service repercussions.

stories.title: Savarino sues NFTA over DL&W Terminal redevelopment
stories.summary: Savarino companies claim the NFTA improperly terminated their development agreement after years of work and at least $1.4 million in expenses.

stories.title: Police Departments including BPD explore use of drones as first responders
stories.summary: As drones become first responders in parts of the U.S., including Rochester, privacy and cost concerns surface alongside their potential to enhance policing.

stories.title: Bills CB Christian Benford donates $10,000 to provide Thanksgiving meals to Niagara Falls families
stories.summary: Buffalo Bills cornerback Christian Benford is helping bring Thanksgiving to families and individuals in need in Niagara Falls at Community Missions.

stories.title: Friends of Night People prepares for Thanksgiving as demand for meals grows
stories.summary: The organization serves more than 7,000 meals a month and is seeking food, clothing and financial donations ahead of its annual holiday lunch.
